nonblocking_findings.finding: The field combines nine-month GAAP EBIT plus acquired amortization, still after actual accounting SBC, with grant-normalized Q4 EBIT. It is a mixed-basis reconstruction, not full-year grant-normalized economic EBIT.
nonblocking_findings.recommended_change: Rename to FY2026_hybrid_actual_YTD_plus_grant_normalized_Q4_ebit or add an explicit basis label. If a full-year comparable grant-normalized measure is needed, use the existing FY2026_normalized_ebit_reference_only, still labeled a reference rather than valued historical cash flow.
nonblocking_findings.closure_test: Retain all headline valuations and sensitivities; rename or explicitly label the hybrid field in any consuming schema. Do not replace the all-NOPAT funding reference with the hybrid number.
